records.title: National And State Highway connectivity in Darbhanga.
details:
i) अमास-दरभंगा एक्सप्रेस वे का 25 प्रतिशत कार्य प्रगति पर है। माननीय सदस्य द्वारा दरभंगा-जयनगर का जो विषय उठाया गया, वह स्वीकृत हो चुका है, उसकी डीपीआर उन्नत स्थिति में है और उस पर बहुत जल्दी कार्यवाही की जाएगी।
ii)अध्यक्ष जी, में इसका उत्तर माननीय सदस्य जी को भिजवा दूंगा।

records.title: Breaking of Kosi Western Embankment
details: (d) National Highway Authority has informed that construction of 10.2 km long Kosi bridge from Bheja to Bakaur between Eastern to Western bund of River Kosi along with the strengthening of embankment in the approach towards Bheja side bund by stone Pitching has started.

records.title: PUCCA Houses Under PMAY-G
details: a: Further, in accordance with the approval of Union Cabinet, a survey is being conducted for the identification of additional eligible rural households under the scheme through Awaas+ 2024 Mobile App which has already been launched on 17.09.2024.

records.title: INCLUSION OF MAITHILI LANGUAGE IN CTET.
details: a to d: The matter of including more language in the CTET Exam was referred to NCTE for further Examination. NCTE has constituted a Committee to revise TET guidelines in terms of NEP 2020 recommendation regarding 5+3+3+4 pedagogical and curriculum structure.

records.title: PHASE-4 OF PMGSY
details: Part (a) & (b) The survey work is presently undergoing to identify the eligible unconnected habitation as per population norms.

records.title: Six-Lane Expressway from Gorakhpur to Siliguri
details: Part (a) to (c) The Detailed Project Report (DPR) involving preliminary survey and alignment study for Gorakhpur-Siliguri is awarded and is in progress. The alignment of the corridor would be based on outcome of DPR.

records.title: INSPECTION TEAM TO CHECK QUALITY OF ROADS.
details: c to d: The report of NQMs has been shared with the State Government for taking further necessary action in the matter and submit an Action Taken Report (ATR) to the Ministry.

records.title: National AYUSH Mission
details: Part (b) to (e) : as per the proposals received from the State Government of Bihar through SAAPs, Ministry of Ayush has supported 4 units of 50 bedded Integrated Ayush Hospital at Patna, Darbhanga, Khagaria, & Gopalganj Districts. As reported by the State Government, a letter has been issued to Bihar Medical Services and Infrastructure Corporation Limited (BMSICL) to prepare the Detailed Project Report (DPR) of 50 Bedded Integrated Ayush Hospital at Darbhanga.
